native_commit_info.subject: BUG: return nan from kempton_taylor_q for a single-taxon sample (#2619)
native_commit_info.body:
* BUG: return nan from kempton_taylor_q for a single-taxon sample

* BUG: calculate Kempton-Taylor quantiles with linear interpolation

Use the interquantile fraction of observed taxa for the numerator and
validate ordered quantile probabilities. Return nan for a single observed
taxon and cover narrow ranges, endpoints and tied abundances. Preserve
Boolean count inputs when calculating quantiles.

* DOC: avoid overlapping upstream changelog additions

Place the singleton fix first in Bug Fixes and the quantile change after
Miscellaneous. Keep both entries within the current development release.

* BUG: preserve the Kempton-Taylor calculation when guarding inputs

Restore the inward-rounded indices, numerator and scientific documentation.
Return nan for fewer than two observed taxa and reject invalid probabilities
or reversed or out-of-bounds rounded indices.

* BUG: handle undefined Kempton-Taylor intervals

* DOC: resolve changelog conflict with main

Refactor error message formatting and improve readability in quantile validation.

native_commit_info.subject: BUG: restrict Sequence case conversion to ASCII letters (#2630)
native_commit_info.body:
Sequence.lowercase() flipped the case bit (0x20) of every selected
character. When the mask covered non-letter positions, gaps, dots and
stop codons became control characters ('-' -> '\r', '.' -> '\x0e',
'*' -> '\n'), and lowercase letters were uppercased. The FASTA and FASTQ
writers use this method for their `lowercase` option, so such masks
silently produced corrupted files.

The `lowercase` constructor parameter treated every byte above 'Z' (90)
as lowercase, so '[', '\\', ']', '^', '_', '`', '{', '|', '}' and '~'
were rewritten in generic Sequence objects (e.g. '_' became DEL) and
flagged as lowercase.

Only convert A-Z to lowercase and a-z to uppercase.

native_commit_info.subject: DOC: fix broken k-mers link on documentation front page (#2609)
native_commit_info.body:
* DOC: fix broken k-mers link on documentation front page

The "k-mers" link in the Biological sequences feature highlight pointed at
skbio.sequence.GrammaredSequence.iter_kmers, which is not a generated API
page and therefore returns 404.

iter_kmers is defined on Sequence, and only a class's own methods get a
standalone generated page: in the autosummary class template, own methods
use :toctree: while inherited ones use autoinherit:: and get no page of
their own. GrammaredSequence only inherits the method, so the target has to
be Sequence.iter_kmers, which resolves correctly.

Verified against the published dev intersphinx inventory: the old target is
absent, the new one resolves to
generated/skbio.sequence.Sequence.iter_kmers.html. Rebuilt the website to
confirm the rendered href changed, and confirmed the new URL returns HTTP
200.

Fixes #2605

* DOC: record the changelog entry under Bug Fixes

The entry is a bug fix, and the contributing guidelines say to describe a
bug fix under the "Bug fixes" section. Renamed the heading from
"Miscellaneous" to "Bug Fixes" to match the sections used by the releases
below (Features / Performance enhancements / Bug Fixes / Miscellaneous).
